Subject: New White Paper: Simplifying the Scope of the PCI Audit

Dear SearchSecurity.com member,

The threshold for PCI compliance is simply a minimum standard. 
Retailers recognize that failure to satisfy the PCI DSS requirements
can lead to financial penalties and leave the organization vulnerable
to attack.  

This white paper details the trends driving the PCI standard, major
challenges facing retailers, how to prepare for a PCI compliance
audit and much more.  

Find out more about how to comply with PCI requirements and read this
white paper today:
